title: Find tasks by name, by person, or by when they are due
description: The list and the board both have a search box, a person filter and a due-date filter now, and the board gained the priority and custom-field filters the list already had. Filters stay in the address, so switching between List and Board keeps them and a filtered view can be sent to somebody.
items: Search matches the task name across the whole list, including rows you have not scrolled to
Pick a person — or Me — and choose whether they are the PIC, the QA reviewer, an assignee, or any of those
Due: overdue, this week, next week, or no due date
Clear on the list now keeps you in the list you were looking at
